facts.text: The DossierStore constructor takes dbPath, else the DOSSIER_DB environment variable, else ./dossier.db.
BlobRoot is the blobs directory beside the resolved database file.
Every OpenConnection sets PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON alongside journal_mode=WAL and busy_timeout=5000.
Initialize returns without writing when RevisionSchemaIsCurrent already reports a current schema.
Initialize takes its write lock with a raw BEGIN IMMEDIATE rather than a deferred transaction.
Inside the write lock Initialize re-checks RevisionSchemaIsCurrent before dropping and recreating the triggers.
The revision counter is seeded with INSERT OR IGNORE from the maximum changes seq, so a deleted row cannot reissue a seq.
at: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO meta(key, value) SELECT

facts.text: A failure inside the write lock rolls back, and a SqliteException from that rollback is swallowed so the original failure is thrown.
RevisionSchemaIsCurrent requires the trigger count to equal TriggerSpecs.Length before it reports a current schema.
It counts only triggers whose stored sql contains INSERT INTO changes, so a half-replaced trigger set is detected.
The schema counts as current only when a meta row with key revision exists as well.
at: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM meta WHERE key = 'revision'

facts.text: Revision falls back to 0 when the meta value is present but is not a parseable integer.
RevisionTriggers builds one trigger for every table and operation pair in TriggerSpecs.
A delete trigger reads the OLD row while insert and update triggers read the NEW row.
For refs the trigger derives subject_id with a subquery on facts and takes fact_id from the ref.
at: SELECT subject_id FROM facts WHERE id =

facts.text: Each trigger bumps meta.revision and then journals the row under that same number, so the journal seq equals the revision.
The ReadSnapshot constructor opens the snapshot with BEGIN DEFERRED, never taking the write lock.
ReadSnapshot.Dispose ends the snapshot with ROLLBACK and swallows a SqliteException because nothing was written.
Command assigns the supplied SqliteTransaction to the new command before setting its text.
Bind converts a null value to DBNull.Value before adding the parameter.
Timestamp formats DateTimeOffset.UtcNow in UTC with the round-trip format specifier O.
A chunk the trim leaves short is skipped with reason too_short and a locator for its line range.
Dump throws DossierRequestException missing_source when Source is blank.
Dump throws DossierRequestException missing_subject when Subject is blank.
The blob file is written only when blobs/<sha256> is not already on disk.
A failed blob write adds blob_failed to Errors and returns before any decoding.
Malformed UTF-8 is reported as parse_failed after the blob has already been written.
An absent or blank Kind defaults to the constant DefaultFactKind.
DefaultSplit chooses heading for .md and .markdown files and none for every other extension.
Split rewrites CRLF and a lone CR to a newline before splitting the text into lines.
The file and none splits each return one chunk running from line 1 through LastContentLine.
A line whose first character is a hash starts a new heading chunk.
Before any heading, the first non-blank line starts the chunk as preamble.
AddChunk trims blank leading and trailing lines and drops the chunk when nothing remains.
LineRangeLocator sends the range as line equal to start plus a selector of the form Lstart-Lend.
AccountPosted records the fact id under Created when the status is new and under Deduped otherwise.
The derived_from ref BuildFact attaches uses kind file and basis observed.
Correlate throws invalid_matcher when a requested matcher is neither same_ref nor shared_tag.
Correlate defaults to the same_ref and shared_tag matchers when Matchers is empty.
Correlate returns an empty response when a named Subject resolves to no ids.
AddSameRefPairs normalizes every ref kind and target with Names.Normalize before grouping.
AddSameRefPairs stores at most one fact id per normalized kind and target group.
AppendSubjectFilter binds one $subject parameter per subject id and appends a subject_id IN filter.
Load throws invalid_profile when the path is blank or the file does not exist.
Load throws invalid_profile when the profile text is not valid JSON.
Load requires the JSON root to be an object.
An unrecognized key is rejected with invalid_profile naming the field.
A numeric field must be a non-negative integer or invalid_profile names the field.
Load rejects a min_file_bytes greater than max_file_bytes when the max limit is positive.
Allowed extensions are lowercased with any leading dot trimmed, and an empty value is rejected.
When name is absent the profile name defaults to the file name without its extension.
Evaluate appends rows in order max_files, min_file_bytes, max_file_bytes, max_total_bytes, allowed_extensions, max_path_depth.
A limit of 0 is rendered as unbounded in the allowed column.
Path depth counts the slash-separated segments of each bundle-relative path and takes the maximum.
An empty file set reports the smallest size, largest size and depth as 0.
The extension row labels md as md (markdown) and a missing extension as (none).
Passed is true only when every row passes.
Render appends a format gap note when the allowed_extensions row failed.
Render appends the profile note as a line when Note is non-empty.
Render prints the profile name and, when SourceUrl is set, the source and retrieved values in parentheses.
